package.name: r7021e_rrt
package.description:
Lab 3 autonomous exploration for the TurtleBot3 Burger: an RRT* path planner and a frontier-clustering exploration gain, plus the navigation loop that drives them.
Deliberately not named r7021e_exploration: that is the course-provided package, which is installed alongside this one and supplies SLAM bring-up, the frontier detector and the path follower.
